items.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
items.teaser: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

items.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
items.teaser: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

items.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
items.teaser: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

items.title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
items.teaser: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

items.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
items.teaser: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

items.title: Samsung Wallet launches USDC accounts on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.teaser: Samsung Wallet's Stablecoin Account is now live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, allowing them to use USDC on Solana.

items.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
items.teaser: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

items.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit but misses revenue estimates
items.teaser: Revenue fell to $63.4 million in the third quarter and missed analysts’ forecasts as bitcoin production declined and higher summer electricity prices pushed mining costs up.
